generic_rule.instructions: The state is a candidate rule an AI reviewer wants to save so future coding sessions on other tasks benefit. Is it a reusable generic rule rather than a note about this one case?

criteria.true: States a behavior to keep or avoid that applies across tasks and repositories; no task-specific file names, ticket numbers, variable names, or one-off facts
criteria.false: Describes a specific bug, file, command, value, or event from the current task; would not help a different task
